entries.0b85798f9e42f0b1: Business that manufactures and sells edible collagen casings for sausages. The company manufactures products from purchased processed raw materials and sells them to users in Japan and overseas. Part of exports is routed through the overseas consolidated subsidiary NIPPI COLLAGEN NA INC. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,236 million.
entries.1fca8dd66f2b8806: Business that imports and sells Italian foodstuffs, organic grains and fertilizers, and manufactures and sells chemical products, linker products, BSE testing kits, and the iPS cell culture substrate “iMatrix Series” and others. Consolidated subsidiaries Daiho Shoji Co., Ltd. and Okura Fuzu Co., Ltd. handle import and sales, and the company manufactures the iMatrix Series and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,263 million.
entries.20ed8f0f7489433d: Business that manufactures and sells cosmetics and health foods containing collagen. Skin care gels and similar products are manufactured by the company, while “Nippi Collagen 100” and collagen-containing cosmetics are outsourced for manufacture. Finished products are sold to users through Nippi Collagen Keshohin Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary that is a mail-order company. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,256 million.
entries.31185997e44c9178: Italian foodstuffs, organic grains and fertilizers
entries.3ce926edbfcedad7: A materials manufacturer born from leather, handling gelatin, collagen casings for sausages, cosmetics, leather and other products.
entries.6548a401c5ca1d95: Business that leases land, buildings and equipment. The company leases real estate mainly in Adachi-ku, Tokyo, and Naniwa-ku, Osaka. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,058 million.
entries.69f3d892198fd566: Business that sells leather for shoes, bags and automobiles, as well as leather-related products. Consolidated subsidiary Nippi Fujita Co., Ltd. and others purchase shoe leather and automotive leather from Japan and overseas and sell them. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,852 million.

entries.b43f75694718c8f9: Business that imports, manufactures and sells gelatin and collagen peptides for food, pharmaceutical and industrial use. The company procures raw materials and semi-finished products from overseas, processes and manufactures them, and sells them to users in Japan and overseas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,585 million, the largest of the six businesses.
